control_red.assertion: Durable Discord owner control was unavailable.

help_surface_red.assertion: Longer registry help crossed the delivery chunk boundary; the test incorrectly treated a second chunk as the next command response.

verified: Discord status/pause/resume accept optional explicit workflow; use selects only a workflow bound to the authenticated owner/private conversation. Unknown or ambiguous workflows cannot authorize changes.

Control results and acknowledgement intents commit atomically with owner-control mutation or selection. Injected acknowledgement insert failure rolls back pause, audit, ordering frontier and selection.

Replays preserve original target/result across restart; changed message identity/payload and admission/control request identity collisions reject. A delayed implicit control rejects when the selection changes; replay never retargets it.

Message ordering plus shared owner-control revision checks prevent observed stale resume from overriding a newer pause. GitHub access is checked again, and resume uses shared native/provider/resource readiness.

Production gateway adapter with real temporary Git and scripted GitHub verifies duplicate pause, blocked resume, status, selection, revoked permission and immutable rejected replay after access returns.
Control acknowledgement recovery uses the shared queued-to-uncertain claim and exact bound receipt; uncertain sends are not blindly resent. Original admission reply serialization remains readable.
Shared status distinguishes merge and deployment; unknown deployment remains unknown. Paused owner state does not claim process teardown.
limits: No production deployment, live Discord/native acceptance, hosted CI acceptance or soak completion. No issue closed and no improved throughput claim.
Native Codex/Claude PR coding follow-ups, safe-boundary session acquisition, scope revision/re-review and provider handoff remain unfinished.
Pause quiescence, resume wait/authority options, cancel/model/adopt/readopt and delivery controls remain open.
Automatic progress/deployment updates, unknown-send reconciliation, retry/backoff/dead-letter and destination rebind remain open. This change implements durable control acknowledgements only.
Ordering protects against observed stale or changed selection and immutable retries; it cannot infer unseen messages or promise globally ordered delivery.
